requirements.label: physics-declaration
requirements.title: Physics sequence required to declare the minor
requirements.sourceText: To declare the minor in Bioengineering, students must complete PHY 131, PHY 132, PHY 133, and PHY 134 with grades of C or higher (Note: the following alternate physics sequences are acceptable: PHY 125, PHY 126, PHY 127, PHY 133 and PHY 134 or PHY 141, PHY 142, PHY 133 and PHY 134.).

requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required Courses for each Track
requirements.sourceText: Required Courses for each Track: BME 100 - Introduction to Biomedical Engineering 3 credits; BME 120 - Programming Fundamentals in Biomedical Engineering 3 credits

requirements.label: specialization-tracks
requirements.title: Specialization Tracks (complete one track)
requirements.sourceText: Biomaterials/Biomechanics: BME 260 - Statics and Dynamics in Biological Systems 4 credits; BME 303 - Biomechanics 3 credits; BME 353 - Introduction to Biomaterials 3 credits OR BME 381 - Nanofabrication in Biomedical Applications 3 credits; Calculus III: AMS 261 - Applied Calculus III 4 credits OR MAT 203 - Calculus III with Applications 4 credits. Bioelectricity: BME 271 - Introduction to Electric Circuits and Bioelectricity 3 credits; BME 301 - Bioelectricity 3 credits; BME 311 - Fundamentals of Macro to Molecular Bioimaging 3 credits OR BME 313 - Bioinstrumentation 3 credits OR BME 481 - Biosensors 3 credits; Linear Algebra: AMS 210 - Applied Linear Algebra 3 credits OR MAT 211 - Introduction to Linear Algebra 3 credits. Molecular/Cellular: BME 304 - Genetic Engineering 3 credits; BME 381 - Nanofabrication in Biomedical Applications 3 credits; PICK TWO: BME 404 - Essentials of Tissue Engineering 3 credits, BME 402 - Contemporary Biotechnology 3 credits, BME 371 - Biological Microfluidics 3 credits

notes.text: Priority is given to students with a grade point average of 3.00 or higher. Admission is competitive and contingent upon program capacity.

The Bioengineering minor is the same as the Biomedical Engineering Specialization track within the Biology major. It is designed for College of Arts and Sciences students. Contact the Bioengineering undergraduate program director or coordinator (bme_ug_program@stonybrook.edu) for advising.
